text:
You follow the shadows to spy on
them. Make a L5 Stealth roll. If you
succeed, you are not seen and you
may steal d6 Food point from the
sewer people. If you fail, you are
caught in the act and the sewer
dwelling sub-humans will try to kill
you.

d6+3 sewer people, L2, 1 Life,
damage 1. Loot: 6 Food points.
You may bribe your way out of this
fight by succeeding an L5
Charisma roll (roll at +1 if you have
Charisma, and +2 if you have it at
Expert level) and giving them all of
your Food, as long as you have at
least 1 Food point. If you give 6 or
more Food points, gain a +1
modifier to the Charisma roll.

zh-CN.title: 12 - 下水道居民
text: 你循着阴影跟踪他们，想暗中窥探。进行一次L5潜行检定。成功则不会被发现，可以从下水道居民那里偷走1D6点食物。失败则当场被抓，这些住在下水道的亚人会试图杀死你。
1D6+3名下水道居民：L2，每人1点生命，伤害1。战利品：6点食物。只要你至少有1点食物，就可以通过一次L5魅力检定贿赂他们，脱离战斗，并交出你所有的食物。拥有魅力技能时检定+1，专家级时+2。若交出6点或更多食物，魅力检定额外+1。
